polity.zh: 新尼德兰（荷兰西印度公司）

polity.en: British-occupied; claimed by the United States
polity.zh: 英军占领，美国主张主权

summary.en: The Lenape island of Mannahatta became the Dutch trading town of New Amsterdam in 1625, was renamed New York for the Duke of York when England seized it in 1664, briefly became New Orange under a Dutch reconquest, was the seat of the Confederation Congress from 1785 and the first capital under the Constitution in 1789–90.
summary.zh: 莱纳佩人的曼纳哈塔岛于1625年成为荷兰贸易城镇新阿姆斯特丹；1664年英格兰夺取该地后以约克公爵之名改称纽约，荷兰短暂收复时又一度名为新奥兰治；1785年起是邦联国会驻地，1789至1790年为宪法下的第一个首都。

sources.title: Russell Shorto, The Island at the Center of the World (2004)
Edwin G. Burrows & Mike Wallace, Gotham: A History of New York City to 1898 (1999)

note: The start date of the Lenape name is nominal; Mannahatta was in use long before European contact. The British occupied the city 1776–1783. The British evacuated on 25 November 1783.

name.zh: 霍切拉加（易洛魁城镇，约1600年前消失）

summary.en: Jacques Cartier visited the Iroquoian town of Hochelaga in 1535. French missionaries founded Ville-Marie on the island in 1642, and the name of the island's mountain, Mont Royal, gave the town its lasting name, Montréal. It was capital of the Province of Canada until rioters burned the parliament in 1849.
summary.zh: 1535年雅克·卡蒂埃造访了易洛魁城镇霍切拉加。1642年法国传教士在岛上建立维尔玛丽，岛上皇家山的名称后来成为该城的永久名称蒙特利尔。它曾是加拿大省首府，直到1849年暴徒焚毁议会大楼。

sources.title: Pointe-à-Callière, Montréal Archaeology and History Complex

note: The name Ville-Marie gave way to Montréal gradually in the late 17th century; 1700 is a conventional boundary.

name.zh: 斯塔达科纳（易洛魁城镇）

summary.en: Founded by Champlain in 1608 near the site of the vanished Iroquoian village of Stadacona, Québec was the capital of New France, of British Quebec and of Lower Canada, and alternated as capital of the Province of Canada. Its walled old town is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
summary.zh: 魁北克由尚普兰于1608年在已消失的易洛魁村落斯塔达科纳旧址附近建立，先后是新法兰西、英属魁北克省和下加拿大的首府，也曾轮流担任加拿大省首府。其城墙环绕的老城是联合国教科文组织世界遗产。

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage: Historic District of Old Québec

name.zh: 泰亚亚贡／多伦多（塞内卡人、后为密西沙加人村落）

polity.zh: 豪德诺索尼人，后为密西沙加人（阿尼什纳比族）

polity.en: British Province of Quebec / Upper Canada
polity.zh: 英属魁北克省／上加拿大

summary.en: The name Toronto, from a Mohawk word for "where trees stand in the water" (the fishing weirs at the narrows above Lake Simcoe), spread down the Toronto Carrying-Place to the Seneca village of Teiaiagon and a French fort on Lake Ontario. Governor John Graves Simcoe renamed the site York in 1793 and made it the capital of Upper Canada; the city took back the name Toronto on incorporation in 1834.
summary.zh: “多伦多”一名源自莫霍克语，意为“树木立于水中之地”（原指锡姆科湖北面狭水道上的捕鱼栅栏），后沿多伦多陆运通道南传，用来称呼安大略湖畔塞内卡人的泰亚亚贡村和一座法国堡垒。1793年总督约翰·格雷夫斯·西姆科把此地改名为约克，定为上加拿大首府；1834年建市时，该城恢复了多伦多之名。

sources.title: City of Toronto Archives: Toronto history FAQs

note: Teiaiagon was occupied c. 1670–1687 and later by Mississauga people; early dates are approximate.

name.en: Presidio and Mission San Francisco de Asís (Yelamu Ohlone land)
name.zh: 圣弗朗西斯科要塞与圣方济各传教站（耶拉穆奥隆人的土地）

polity.zh: 新西班牙（上加利福尼亚）

name.zh: 圣弗朗西斯科（要塞与传教站）

polity.zh: 墨西哥（1846年起被美军占领）

summary.en: Spain founded a presidio and mission named for St. Francis of Assisi on Ohlone land in 1776. The trading village that grew up at the cove nearby was called Yerba Buena, after a wild mint, until its American alcalde renamed it San Francisco in January 1847, a year before the Gold Rush. Chinese immigrants called it the Old Gold Mountain (Jiujinshan).
summary.zh: 1776年，西班牙在奥隆人的土地上建立了以阿西西的圣方济各命名的要塞和传教站。附近海湾旁兴起的贸易村落以一种野薄荷命名为“耶尔巴布埃纳”（芳草地），1847年1月才由美国镇长改名为旧金山（圣弗朗西斯科），时在淘金热前一年。华人移民称之为“旧金山”。

sources.title: National Park Service: Presidio of San Francisco

name.zh: 奇卡古（迪萨布勒的贸易站）

polity.en: Potawatomi lands (claimed by Britain, then the US)
polity.zh: 波塔瓦托米人的土地（先后被英国和美国主张）

name.zh: 芝加哥（迪尔伯恩堡旁的聚落）

polity.zh: 美国（印第安纳领地，后属伊利诺伊）

summary.en: The name comes from a Miami-Illinois word for a wild onion or leek that grew along the river. Jean Baptiste Point du Sable, a trader of African descent, settled there in the 1780s; the US Army built Fort Dearborn in 1803, and the settlement around it was incorporated as the town of Chicago in 1833 and as a city in 1837.
summary.zh: “芝加哥”一名源自迈阿密—伊利诺伊语中指河边野葱的词。非裔商人让·巴蒂斯特·普安·迪萨布勒于18世纪80年代在此定居；1803年美军修建迪尔伯恩堡，其周围的聚落于1833年建镇、1837年建市，名为芝加哥。

sources.title: Encyclopedia of Chicago (Newberry Library / Chicago History Museum)

note: Du Sable's arrival is dated variously between 1779 and 1785.

polity.zh: 法属路易斯安那（1722年起为首府）

summary.en: Named for Philippe II, Duke of Orléans, regent of France, La Nouvelle-Orléans became the capital of French Louisiana. Ceded to Spain in 1763 (Spanish rule effective from 1766–69), it was rebuilt in brick after fires in 1788 and 1794, returned briefly to France, and was transferred to the United States in December 1803.
summary.zh: 新奥尔良以法国摄政王奥尔良公爵腓力二世命名，曾是法属路易斯安那的首府。1763年割让给西班牙（西班牙实际统治始于1766至1769年），1788年和1794年两次大火后以砖石重建，后短暂回归法国，并于1803年12月移交美国。

sources.title: Lawrence N. Powell, The Accidental City: Improvising New Orleans (2012)

polity.zh: 加拿大省（1857年被选为首都）

summary.en: The construction camp of the Rideau Canal, begun in 1826 by Lieutenant Colonel John By, became Bytown, a rough lumber town. Renamed Ottawa, after the Algonquin-language name of the Odawa people and the river, on incorporation as a city in 1855, it was chosen by Queen Victoria in 1857 as capital of the Province of Canada and became the Dominion's capital in 1867.
summary.zh: 1826年约翰·拜中校开始修建里多运河，其施工营地发展为粗犷的伐木小镇拜镇。1855年建市时以渥太华族和渥太华河的阿尔冈昆语名称改名为渥太华，1857年被维多利亚女王选为加拿大省首都，1867年成为自治领首都。

name.zh: 底特律河畔的蓬查特兰堡

polity.zh: 英国（魁北克省，后属上加拿大）

summary.en: Antoine de la Mothe Cadillac founded Fort Pontchartrain du Détroit, "on the strait" between Lakes Huron and Erie, in 1701. Taken by the British in 1760, besieged by Pontiac in 1763, held by Britain until 1796 and captured briefly in 1812, it became the American motor city.
summary.zh: 1701年，安托万·德·拉莫特·卡迪拉克在休伦湖与伊利湖之间的“海峡”上建立了底特律河畔的蓬查特兰堡。1760年英军夺取此地，1763年庞蒂亚克围城，英国一直据守到1796年，1812年又被英军短暂攻占；后来它成为美国的汽车城。

sources.title: Detroit Historical Society: Encyclopedia of Detroit

name.zh: 红河殖民地（道格拉斯堡）

polity.zh: 鲁珀特地（哈德逊湾公司）
鲁珀特地（哈德逊湾公司）
加拿大（马尼托巴省省会）

summary.en: At the Forks of the Red and Assiniboine rivers, a meeting place for thousands of years, Lord Selkirk's settlers founded the Red River Colony in 1812. The Hudson's Bay Company's Fort Garry became its centre and the seat of Riel's provisional government in 1869–70. The city was incorporated as Winnipeg, from the Cree for "muddy waters", in 1873.
summary.zh: 红河与阿西尼博因河交汇的“岔口”数千年来一直是聚会之地。1812年塞尔扣克勋爵的移民在此建立红河殖民地。哈德逊湾公司的加里堡成为其中心，1869至1870年又是里埃尔临时政府所在地。1873年建市时取克里语“浑浊之水”之意，定名温尼伯。

sources.title: Parks Canada: The Forks National Historic Site

note: Upper Fort Garry was built in 1835; earlier HBC posts at the Forks also bore the name Fort Garry from 1822.

polity.zh: 西属佛罗里达（东佛罗里达）

summary.en: Founded by Pedro Menéndez de Avilés in 1565 at the Timucua village of Seloy, San Agustín was the capital of Spanish Florida for two centuries, became the capital of British East Florida in 1763, returned to Spain in 1784 and passed to the United States with Florida in 1821.
summary.zh: 圣阿古斯丁由佩德罗·梅嫩德斯·德·阿维莱斯于1565年在帖木夸人的塞洛伊村建立，两个世纪里一直是西属佛罗里达的首府；1763年成为英属东佛罗里达首府，1784年归还西班牙，1821年随佛罗里达转归美国。

sources.title: National Park Service: Castillo de San Marcos
Kathleen Deagan, Spanish St. Augustine: The Archaeology of a Colonial Creole Community (1983)

note: British troops took over in 1763–64 and the Spanish returned formally in 1784.

polity.zh: 特林吉特人（基克萨迪氏族）

polity.en: United States (Department, then District of Alaska)
polity.zh: 美国（阿拉斯加军区，后为阿拉斯加区）

summary.en: The Tlingit town of Shee Atiká on Baranof Island destroyed a first Russian post in 1802. After the Battle of Sitka in 1804, Alexander Baranov built Novo-Arkhangelsk, capital of Russian America from 1808. Renamed Sitka after the 1867 transfer, it remained Alaska's capital until 1906.
summary.zh: 巴拉诺夫岛上的特林吉特城镇谢阿提卡于1802年摧毁了俄国人的第一座据点。1804年锡特卡之战后，亚历山大·巴拉诺夫修建了新阿尔汉格尔斯克，1808年起为俄属美洲首府。1867年移交后改名锡特卡，直至1906年一直是阿拉斯加首府。

sources.title: National Park Service: Sitka National Historical Park
Lydia T. Black, Russians in Alaska, 1732–1867 (2004)

note: The start date of the Tlingit name is nominal; the Tlingit town long predates contact.

polity.zh: 卡拉利特人（格陵兰因纽特人）

summary.en: The missionary Hans Egede arrived in 1721 and set up his first station on an island off the Nuuk fjord; in 1728 the royal governor Claus Paarss moved the colony to the mainland as Godthåb ("Good Hope"), near Inuit settlements. Nuuk means "the cape" in Greenlandic. It was the colonial capital and took the name Nuuk with home rule in 1979.
summary.zh: 传教士汉斯·埃格德于1721年抵达，在努克峡湾外的岛上设立了第一个传教站；1728年，王室总督克劳斯·帕尔斯将殖民地迁至大陆，命名为戈特霍布（意为“美好希望”），邻近因纽特人聚落。“努克”在格陵兰语中意为“岬角”。这里一直是殖民地首府，1979年实行地方自治后改名为努克。

sources.title: Nuuk Local Museum (Nuutoqaq) / Greenland National Museum
Finn Gad, The History of Greenland, vol. 2 (1973)

note: Egede's first station (1721) was on Kangeq/Håbets Ø; Paarss moved the colony to the present site in 1728 (some sources credit Egede with the move). The start date of the Inuit name is nominal.

summary.en: A traditional Inuit fishing place, Iqaluit ("place of many fish"), became the site of a US Army Air Forces base in 1942 and of a town named Frobisher Bay, after the Elizabethan explorer Martin Frobisher. The community restored its Inuktitut name in 1987 and became capital of Nunavut in 1999.
summary.zh: 伊卡卢伊特（意为“鱼多之地”）原是因纽特人的传统渔场，1942年成为美国陆军航空队基地所在地，随后形成的城镇以伊丽莎白时代的探险家马丁·弗罗比舍命名为弗罗比舍湾。1987年社区恢复了因纽特语名称，1999年成为努纳武特首府。

name.zh: 吉普图克（米克马克语“大港”）

polity.zh: 米克马基（米克马克人故土）
加拿大（新斯科舍省省会）

summary.en: Edward Cornwallis founded Halifax in 1749 as a British naval base and capital of Nova Scotia, on the Mi'kmaq harbour of Kjipuktuk, to counter French Louisbourg. It was the main North Atlantic base of the Royal Navy and, in both world wars, Canada's chief convoy port.
summary.zh: 1749年，爱德华·康沃利斯在米克马克人称为吉普图克的港湾建立哈利法克斯，作为英国海军基地和新斯科舍首府，以抗衡法国的路易斯堡。这里曾是皇家海军在北大西洋的主要基地，两次世界大战中又是加拿大首要的护航船队港口。

note: The start date of the Mi'kmaq name is nominal.

name.en: El Pueblo de la Reina de los Ángeles

polity.zh: 新西班牙（上加利福尼亚）

summary.en: Near the Tongva village of Yaanga, 44 settlers of mostly African, Indigenous and mixed descent founded the pueblo of Our Lady the Queen of the Angels in 1781. Under Mexico it was at times capital of Alta California, and it passed to the United States in 1848.
summary.zh: 1781年，44名大多具有非洲、原住民或混血血统的移民在通瓦人亚安加村附近建立了“天使女王圣母镇”。在墨西哥统治下它一度是上加利福尼亚的首府，1848年转归美国。

sources.title: El Pueblo de Los Ángeles Historical Monument

note: The pueblo's full name is recorded in several forms; the start date of the Tongva name is nominal.

summary.en: At the Forks of the Ohio, where the Allegheny and Monongahela meet, the French built Fort Duquesne in 1754. The British took the ruins in 1758 and named the new Fort Pitt and its village for William Pitt the Elder. Pittsburgh grew into the steel capital of the United States.
summary.zh: 在阿勒格尼河与莫农加希拉河交汇而成俄亥俄河的“岔口”，法国人于1754年修建了迪凯纳堡。1758年英军占领其废墟，以老威廉·皮特之名命名新建的皮特堡及其村落。匹兹堡后来发展为美国的钢铁之都。

sources.title: Heinz History Center: Fort Pitt Museum

note: The 1758–1776 entry spans colonial Pennsylvania; Pittsburgh was laid out in 1764 and incorporated in 1794 (city 1816).

name.zh: 弗隆特纳克堡（卡塔拉奎）

summary.en: Governor Frontenac built a fort at Cataraqui, where Lake Ontario flows into the St. Lawrence, in 1673. Resettled by Loyalists after 1783 and named King's Town for George III, Kingston became a naval base in the War of 1812, the southern end of the Rideau Canal, and the first capital of the united Province of Canada (1841–44).
summary.zh: 1673年，弗隆特纳克总督在安大略湖流入圣劳伦斯河处的卡塔拉奎修建堡垒。1783年后效忠派在此重新定居，以乔治三世之名命名为“国王镇”。金斯顿在1812年战争中是海军基地，也是里多运河的南端，并于1841至1844年担任统一后的加拿大省的第一个首府。

sources.title: Parks Canada: Fort Henry and Kingston Fortifications

note: The settlement was known as Cataraqui and King's Town in the 1780s; "Kingston" was in general use by 1788.
